subject: Confirmation of Flight Booking
body: Dear Mr. Smith, We are pleased to confirm your flight booking for your upcoming trip to Paris. Your flight details are as follows: Flight: ABC123, Departure: 15th September 2022 10:00 AM, Arrival: 15th September 2022 2:00 PM. Please review the attached itinerary for more information. Should you have any questions or need assistance, feel free to contact our customer support team. We look forward to welcoming you on board!
